acceptance_basis: Three unchanged real-montage controls passed gameplay and pose/frame eligibility. Representative side-view frames were inspected for participant framing. A 10 cm margin above the largest observed step defines a conservative mechanical envelope; it is not artistic acceptance or a contact/foot-support threshold. Validate sensitivity with the separate 200 cm displacement control and fresh unmodified runs.
meaning: A sampled displacement envelope for this scenario/point/resolution; neither a universal defect threshold nor artistic approval
replacement_rationale: Final report presentation adds explicit unmeasured outcomes, intervals and frame links, and corrects the capture-disabled link. The same immutable captures were re-evaluated; the measurement algorithm, observed values and thresholds are unchanged.
